## Tickets

Standard admission at the ticket office €23  
Standard admission online €21  
Discounted admission €13  
Under 18-year-olds €0  
Museum Card: free entry. Please show your card at the ticket office.

## Arrival

Kaivokatu 2  
00100 Helsinki  
Accessible entrance from Ateneuminkuja

## **Ateneum Guide enhances your experience**

The Ateneum Guide offers audio descriptions to enrich the exhibition experience of *A Question of Time*. The audio guide works with your phone’s internet browser.

[Open the audio guide](https://ateneum.guide/61)

## How do I buy tickets online?

You can buy advance tickets for exhibitions and some events in our webshop. Here you can find answers to the most common questions about buying and using tickets.

[Read more about buying advance tickets](https://ateneum.fi/en/how-do-i-buy-tickets-online/)

## **Explore the entire art collection**

The works in our collection can be explored on the Finnish National Gallery website. You can search for works by title, year, artist’s name, or theme. Copyright-free works can be downloaded.

[Search the Finnish National Gallery collection](https://www.kansallisgalleria.fi/en/search?category=artwork&hasImage=true&museums[]=ateneum)

![Helmi Biese: Coastal cliffs at Villinki (the 1890s). Finnish Nationa Gallery / Ateneum Art Museum. Photo: Finnish National Gallery / Jenni Nurminen](https://ateneum.fi/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2020/12/KG2020DK831-1024x701.jpg)

## Museum shop online

The museum shop is online! Visit our web shop to explore the Finnish National Gallery’s selection and have your order shipped to your home. Discover the novelties from new exhibitions and take a look at the best-selling classics.
